about: Each way of ending a session's stlink-server 2.1.1 once its ST-LINK_gdbserver 7.14.0 was killed, cycle after cycle on the reference board in the bench container, recorded by tests/bench/st_link_gdbserver_recordings.py (the server ends round): at once, after its side of the GDB server's connection closed, after it released the probe's USB node, and after half a second, each followed at once by the next start, and the last cycles by OpenOCD's probe_target.
bundle: STM32CubeCLT 1.22.0 for Linux, extracted from its installer without running it
image: the demo firmware the tier builds
probe: the bench's in-circuit debugger, its serial number redacted
